# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 and managed perf ports** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and ports several hot paths to allocation-free managed C#. Ports SKColor/SKColorF conversion, PMColor premultiplication, and HarfBuzzSharp buffer/tag parsing to allocation-free managed code, adds Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries with new exception handling, and fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — Bumps the bundled Skia engine to Chrome milestone m151, including several rounds of upstream bug-fix merges and a fix restoring SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to resolve a CPU raster regression. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed** — Fixes a native resource leak when creating an SKImage from encoded data with an explicit subset rectangle. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Platform

- **WASM exception handling and Emscripten 5.0.6** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries and a preview-.NET WASM test job, and rebuilds the emsdk libraries with the new exnref exception-handling model to catch regressions earlier. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Makes HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free via pooled UTF-8 encoding and removes a per-call char[4] allocation in Tag.Parse.

## Release Candidate 1 (July 21, 2026)

The release candidate ports SKColor/SKColorF conversion and single-value PMColor premultiplication to managed math, adds the Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries and exception-handling test coverage, fixes the SKImage.FromEncodedData resource leak, and merges the final round of upstream m151 bug fixes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.2.1...v4.151.0-rc.1.1)

## Preview 2 (July 14, 2026)

Preview 2 ports SKShaper glyph reads, SKFourByteTag.Parse, and HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8 to allocation-free managed code, restores the legacy shader context to fix a CPU raster regression, and merges further upstream m151 fixes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.1.1...v4.151.0-preview.2.1)

## Preview 1 (July 2, 2026)

Preview 1 opens the 4.151.0 line by updating Skia to milestone m151 and bumping the Skia submodule to drop the SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.150.2...v4.151.0-preview.1.1)
